ns2:course.label: International Organization
ns2:course.description: Examines the development of basic principles underlying world organization; also considers the principles, structure, methods, and operation of international governmental institutions. Gives special attention to the United Nations and related agencies and to their evolution from the League of Nations system. Credit is not given for both PS 383 and PS 395. Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 281 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
